subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Insider Trading
description: Learn Insider Trading in one minute.

hook.text: A CEO's friend buys stock days before a merger announcement. The stock doubles. Coincidence?

buildup.text: Insider trading means trading stocks based on confidential information the public doesn't have.

discovery.text: It's illegal because it gives insiders an unfair advantage and erodes trust in markets.

twist.text: Detecting insider trading is incredibly difficult. The SEC catches only a fraction of offenders.

climax.text: Martha Stewart went to prison for just $45,000 in avoided losses — the cover-up was worse than the trade.

punchline.text: The trade was small. The lie about it was the crime.

quiz.question: Why is insider trading illegal?
options: It gives insiders unfair advantage over the public
